name: agent-handoff
description: Coordinate multi-agent AI development workflows via agent-handoff. Create ChangeSets, queue implementation tasks, poll for results, and manage HITL approval gates.

endpoints.name: health_check
endpoints.description: Check if the agent-handoff server is running. No auth required.

endpoints.name: create_change_set
endpoints.description: Create a new ChangeSet — the unit of work representing one task, one git worktree, and one FSM lifecycle. Returns the ChangeSet ID needed for subsequent calls.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Human-readable title for the task, e.g. 'Add rate limiting to POST /api/users'

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task identifier in TSK_NNNNNN format, e.g. 'TSK_000001'

parameters.name: targetBranch
parameters.description: Git branch to base the worktree on. Defaults to 'main'.

parameters.name: specContent
parameters.description: Full task specification in markdown. Stored as the agent's task spec.

endpoints.name: queue_task
endpoints.description: Queue a task for an agent session to pick up. The agent will implement, review, or otherwise process the ChangeSet according to its assigned role.

parameters.name: changeSetId
parameters.description: ChangeSet ID returned by create_change_set, in chg_NNNNNN format

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Agent role to assign. One of: implementer, reviewer, fixer, planner, qa_agent, summarizer

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Optional override prompt for the agent. If omitted, the role's default system prompt is used.

endpoints.name: poll_task
endpoints.description: Poll the status of a queued task. Call repeatedly until status is 'completed' or 'failed'. Status values: queued, running, completed, failed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Task ID in TSK_NNNNNN format, as returned by queue_task

endpoints.name: transition_change_set
endpoints.description: Advance the ChangeSet FSM via a named trigger. Returns the updated ChangeSet, or 202 with approvalId when a HITL gate is hit (e.g. approve, merge).

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: FSM trigger name. Common values: start_implementation, submit_for_review, request_changes, approve, merge

endpoints.name: approve_hitl_gate
endpoints.description: Approve a pending HITL (human-in-the-loop) gate. Use the approvalId returned by a 202 response from transition_change_set.

parameters.name: approvalId
parameters.description: UUID returned in the approvalId field of a 202 response

parameters.name: decided_by
parameters.description: Identity of the approver, e.g. 'openclaw-skill' or a user name. Stored in the audit log.
